sourceReview.observation: The already-validated-metrics GetGlyphIndex overload rescans cmap encoding records and validates the selected format-4 segment array on each scalar lookup. Canonical coverage, decomposition/composition and final shaping call the same reader repeatedly. GetGlyphIndex and format-4 validation are visible in the retained profiles.
sourceReview.boundary: OpenTypeFont is a static borrowed-byte reader that explicitly retains/caches no font bytes. Its unchanged-byte contract, malformed/unused table admission and cancellation must be inspected before moving validation. Sampled GetGlyphIndex frames can include inlined work; counts alone do not prove a particular loop causes a runtime difference.
